subject: PO issuance / backfill request and spend-slice mapping for CloudSlice onboarding
messages:
From: Emily Ramos <emily.ramos@cloudslice.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO reference issuance for CloudSlice onboarding

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CloudSlice is excited to move to a short pilot-to-production path. Legal asked that we get a formal PO in place to cover the piloted usage in Nov and the expected ramp in Jan. Two quick asks from our side so we can close procurement internally: 

1) Can Redwood issue a provisional PO that covers the historical pilot spend (Nov) + the initial month of production? We expect ~$18k for the pilot backfill and ~$30k for the first month of production.

2) We use two charge codes on our side (CORE-CPU, SUPPORT-24x7). Can the PO be split into two line items so they map cleanly to those codes? That prevents manual reclassification on our finance side.

I attached our completed onboarding form and a short invoice summary to help with mapping. If you need a vendor contact or signed copy, happy to loop in finance.

Attachments: [Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf)]

Best,
Emily Ramos
Head of Procurement, CloudSlice
emily.ramos@cloudslice.com
procure@cloudslice.com

---

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Ramos <emily.ramos@cloudslice.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO reference issuance for CloudSlice onboarding

Thanks Emily — looping procurement to action.

Priyom / Irene,

Summary of ask from CloudSlice: provisional PO to backfill November pilot ($18k) + first month production ($30k) = $48k total but they prefer split lines mapped to their charge codes. They specifically requested two line items: CORE-CPU (consumption) and SUPPORT-24x7 (premium support).

Proposed approach:
- Issue two provisional PO lines under one top-level reference for bookkeeping.
- Spend cap per line: CORE-CPU $40,000; SUPPORT-24x7 $8,000 (we keep a bit of buffer for ramp).
- Include note in PO: "Map to CloudSlice codes CORE-CPU / SUPPORT-24x7; backfill coverage Nov pilot + Jan initial month."

I've attached a quick split proposal that maps the invoice lines CloudSlice sent to our ledger codes. Can you confirm whether we should do two separate PO numbers (recommended for audit clarity) or a single PO with two lines? If we do separate PO numbers we can attach the backfill mapping to both.

Attachments: [Attachment: initial-po-split-proposal.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Logan Wright
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

---

From: Emily Ramos <emily.ramos@cloudslice.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO reference issuance for CloudSlice onboarding

Logan — thanks, that layout looks good. We prefer two separate PO numbers (one per charge code) for our internal AP system. Confirming the numbers we expect to map are: invoice 2026-1109 (pilot usage) and invoice 2026-1201 (setup & first month).

Attached is the PDF with the two invoice lines and internal GL refs. If you issue two PO numbers, please include both invoice IDs in the description of each PO so our AP can automatically match.

Example line names we need on the PO: 
- "CORE-CPU: CloudSlice consumption (match invoice 2026-1109)"
- "SUPPORT-24x7: Managed support (match invoice 2026-1201)"

Also: who on Redwood will sign the vendor onboarding form? We can accept a PDF scan from legal or a DocuSign link if that helps move things faster.

Attachments: [Attachment: cloudslice_invoice_dec.pdf (application/pdf)]

—Emily

Emily / Logan,

We issued the provisional PO numbers and recorded the backfill mapping in our ledger. Details below: 

- PO-2026-9173 (CORE-CPU) — Line cap $40,000 — Description: "CORE-CPU: CloudSlice consumption — match invoice 2026-1109"
- PO-2026-9174 (SUPPORT-24x7) — Line cap $8,000 — Description: "SUPPORT-24x7: Managed support — match invoice 2026-1201"

Notes on mapping and next steps:
- We've uploaded a CSV to the shared drive with the backfill allocation (Nov pilot lines mapped to PO-2026-9173). Link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D-po-backfill
- For audit, we created two PO records (rather than a single multi-line PO) so CloudSlice can auto-match by PO number.
- Please review the attached issued PO export and confirm GL mapping matches CloudSlice's codes. If everything is good, Emily, please attach the signed onboarding_form (PDF) to your vendor record or return it to procurement for our files.

Attachments: [Attachment: issued-po-records.csv (text/csv)]

Priyom Das
